name: Wild Horse Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A small valley AVA straddling Napa and Solano counties, partly inside Napa Valley. Its petitioners described more sun than nearby areas and cooling from San Pablo Bay.
